title: Signal: Conda channel list relies on `defaults`
scope: A .condarc file that declares a channel list that still contains `defaults`.
limitations: It matches a channel list that still contains `defaults` in the parsed .condarc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .condarc that mentions a channel list that still contains `defaults` in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
